correctness.rationale: For dyadic x of depth n≥4, both maps rewrite the leading four binary digits with exact depth changes +1,−1,0, and D lowers depth by one. The positive prefix-dependent V(x)=s^G(x)a_prefix with s=51/50 and eight stated rational a has P_pV≤(3999/4000)V outside finite depth<4. Independently recomputed all 16 exact rational drift slacks for p=2/5 (min 3409/170000000) and p=1/2 (min 268567/10200000000); affine dependence extends to interval. Also independently tested direct rational maps on all 504 odd-numerator dyadics depth4..9. Foster/tight Cesàro argument gives stationary finite V moment, reachability of 0 under D yields uniqueness; prior Goverse–Kleptsyn theorem supplies p>1/2. Nonpositive expected log slope (2p−1)log2 on (0,1/2) is precisely the counterexample boundary. Finite bit checks prove uniform drift only because all-depth rewrite identity is analytic.
